name: 27617 · Raleigh, NC
findings: ZIP 27617 (Raleigh) has 76 nonprofit organizations. 41 of them (54%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 33 organizations.
Health care organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (17% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 27617 (Raleigh) has fewer organizations offering opportunities per resident.
29% of the organizations offering opportunities have no identified type, so the breakdown by type is partial.

observations.title: Fewer organizations list membership
observations.text: Per resident, fewer organizations in ZIP 27617 (Raleigh) list membership on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 66% of the typical level).
